data_description.host: The --rc-addr rclone is serving on, as host:port. Start it with https:// if rcd serves TLS (--rc-cert) or sits behind an HTTPS reverse proxy; the certificate must be one Home Assistant trusts, such as Let's Encrypt, so self-signed certificates are not supported. Anything after the port is used as the base URL (--rc-baseurl).

data.count_errors_as_failure: Count runs with errors as failed

data_description.count_errors_as_failure: A run can report no error while still leaving errors in its stats. A check that could not list a subdirectory is the usual case: everything it compared matched, but it did not get to see everything. Turn this on to treat those runs as failures for Last Success Time.
